description: Payload-only wrapper for the repaired fx2-cmix -e PHDA9/readalike path
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
notes: compress() runs the bundled fx2 self-extracting cmix with -e but returns only probe.comp. decompress() reconstructs archive9 internally from the bundled binary, bundled compressed dictionary, the payload, and a local header, then executes it to restore the raw prefix.
verdict: Diagnostic candidate. The -e transform improves the 10MB backend payload, but the larger bundled decoder payload makes it worse than the direct xz-packaged fx2 wrapper at 10MB.
